lt.line: Ir aš sakau jums: jūs manęs nebematysite, kol ateis laikas, kada imsite šaukti; 'Garbė tam, kuris ateina Viešpaties vardu!

en.event: Thursday of the Thirtieth Week in Ordinary Time
en.line: But I tell you, you will not see me until the time comes when you say, Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord .
